name: hex-viewer
description: Inspect binary files in compatible Codex clients: hex viewer, NSO/NRO analysis, NSP/XCI container listings, AArch64 disassembly, inferred references and persistent annotations.

interface.longDescription: Opens any binary file as a scrollable hex + ASCII dump with offset jump, byte inspector, format detection (ELF, Mach-O, PE, PNG, ZIP, GameCube DOL/REL/Yaz0/RARC/GCM, ...) and string extraction.
defaultPrompt: Show this binary file in the hex viewer
